title: Binance Completes the FC Porto Fan Token Subscription Launchpad and Will Open Trading for PORTO
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance has completed the subscription format Launchpad for FC Porto Fan Token  and the final token allocation results are now showing on the  FC Porto Fan Token  Launchpad Page . A total of 190,453 participants committed 8,379,322.4306 BNB during the subscription period, representing an oversubscription of 1,280x.  58 participants reached the 10,000 PORTO hard cap, resulting in the participants’ allocation being passed down to the remaining users. For further information on how this is calculated, refer to a detailed guide  here . As a reference for users that participated: Users that committed 50 BNB received an allocation of 25.3706624 PORTO and will have 0.04151655 BNB deducted. Users that committed 500 BNB received an allocation of 253.70662415 PORTO, and will have 0.41516552 BNB deducted. Users that committed 5,000 BNB received an allocation of 2,537.06624163 PORTO and will have 4.1516552 BNB deducted. The corresponding BNB tokens will be deducted from your already-locked BNB balance within 30 minutes of this announcement. Once deducted, your PORTO and remaining BNB tokens will both be transferred to your spot wallet. Binance will list FC Porto Fan Token  (PORTO) in the innovation zone at 2021-11-16 12:00 PM (UTC) and open trading for PORTO/BTC, PORTO/EUR, PORTO/TRY and PORTO/USDT trading pairs. Note: The token purchase price was set at 1 PORTO = 0.00163640 BNB or 1 USD (using a BNB price of 611.10 USD), as per the previous announcement  here . The FC Porto Fan Token (PORTO) BEP-20 smart contract is available  here .
